name: Seducing the Reaper: A Kiara and Calli Fan Game
source:
Can love bloom in the depths of hell? One phoenix intends to find out. Join [url=https://en.hololive.tv/portfolio/items/takanashi-kiara]Takanashi Kiara[/url] in her quest to seduce the tsundereaper [url=https://en.hololive.tv/portfolio/items/mori-calliope]Calliope Mori[/url] through three DDR-style rhythm games in this rhythm game/dating sim hybrid.

[From [url=https://jackrockstar.itch.io/seducing-the-reaper]Itch.io[/url]]
